new_jobs.title: Operations & Projects Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Role Type:** Full\-Time \| Individual Contributor **Experience:** 1 to 5 years, ideally as a founder's/CEO's right hand or a project manager at a startup **About the Role** We're moving fast, and we're running on multiple fronts at once: cross\-border market expansion, physical site setups, vendor coordination, and new initiatives that don't have a playbook yet. These things all share one trait. Someone needs to own them from start to finish, not have them chopped up and handed to five different people. That's what this role is for. You'll work directly with the CEO, and you won't be handed busywork. You'll be handed a whole project: figure out what's going on, find the right people, build the timeline, and see it through to done. One week it might be sorting out compliance paperwork for a cross\-border shipment. The next it might be managing vendors on a physical site build. The month after, it could be something we haven't even named yet. Whatever it is, it's yours to run. We're not asking you to already know the regulations or the industry. We're asking whether, when you're handed something you've never done before, you can figure it out fast, track down the right resources, and get it done. By the time this job is done shaping you, you'll have built a combination of skills that most people never get in a single role: cross\-border compliance, physical operations, and running multiple projects at once without dropping any of them. **What You'll Do** * **Own projects end to end** , from cross\-border compliance paperwork to vendor and partner coordination. * **Run physical site operations** , including setup logistics, vendor management, and progress tracking. * **Juggle multiple live projects** , setting your own priorities to hit deadlines without sacrificing quality. * **Be the connective tissue** between internal teams and external partners, keeping communication clear on both sides. * **Solve unfamiliar problems on your own.** When you hit a process or regulation you've never seen, you dig in, find the answer, and move forward. * **Use AI tools** (Gemini, Claude, and similar) to speed up research, drafting, and getting up to speed on new tasks. * **Shift gears when priorities change.** You stay steady even when the workload gets unpredictable. * **Keep the CEO in the loop** , flagging what's working, what's not, and what needs attention next. **Who This Is For** * **You're moving fast in your career and want more responsibility** , not a comfortable seat where nothing changes. * **You've been a founder's or CEO's right hand, or a project manager** , and you're used to running several things at once and piecing together the full picture when the information is incomplete. * **You care about whether things actually get done.** You'd rather ship results than write a status report about them. * **You're not scared off by tasks with no precedent.** Your speed and judgment in figuring things out are your edge. * **You want full ownership of a project** , not a slice of one where you never see the whole thing. **What We Look For** * 1 to 5 years of experience, ideally as a founder's/CEO's right hand, a project manager, or something close to it. * A track record of picking up new industries or skills fast. We care more about your trajectory than how long you've stayed anywhere. * Hands\-on experience in project management, event execution, or on\-the\-ground coordination is a strong plus. * Comfortable with priorities shifting constantly and tasks changing shape without warning. If routine bores you, that's a good sign. * Detail\-oriented and patient enough to handle paperwork and process without cutting corners. * Written and reading fluency in both Mandarin and English (some documents will be in English; negotiation\-level fluency isn't required). * Comfortable with everyday tools like Google Workspace and Notion. * You already use AI tools like Gemini or Claude to get work done faster and don't think twice about it. **Why Join Us** * **Direct line to the CEO.** No layers of middle management between you and the decisions. You'll see how the company actually operates. * **Every project is fully yours.** We don't slice work into fragments and spread it across a team. You own it from beginning to end. * **Growth is tied to what you deliver, not your tenure.** The scope of this role will expand along with your results, and so will your authority. * **The role isn't fixed yet.** It's still being defined, and you'll have a real hand in shaping what it becomes.

是一家專門製作瑜伽、跑步、訓練和其他運動項目等機能服飾的創新公司。在高科技布料和功能設計方面，我們樹立標竿，創造顛覆性的產品和體驗，持續在運動健身、心靈成長、人際連結與幸福感方面提供人們所需的協助。我們將成功歸功於創新的產品、對門市的重視、對員工的承諾以及在每個所在社群當中所建立的人際連結。作為一家公司，我們專注於創造正面的改變，期許打造更健康、繁榮的未來。特別值得一提的是，這樣的期許也包含了為我們的員工創造一個公平、包容且注重成長的環境。 **工作摘要** 關鍵領導人一職是門市領導團隊的重要成員，與日常樓面銷售團隊成員和客戶（即顧客）體驗息息相關。關鍵領導人負責以身作則並支援教育專員，在門市推動出色的顧客體驗，並且監督樓面所有營運業務。關鍵領導人運用關鍵績效指標和度量來安排職責優先順序，並且進行日常業務調整和因應挑戰。 **工作的核心職責** **領導力和人員管理** * 提供直接的意見回饋、指導、輔導和職業發展指引，並且妥善處理績效問題，以此方式支援團隊成員持續學習和發展。 * 表彰團隊成員表現、提供技能差距評估和整體績效說明文件，以激勵並加強職涯發展和個人成長。 * 透過適切的溝通管道，發展、維護並傳播產品和一般公司知識。 **客戶（即顧客）體驗和社群** * 支援團隊成員（例如以身作則或提供指導），確保提供卓越顧客體驗，展現對顧客時間的重視，包括評估顧客需求、提供技術產品教育以及支援門市交易和全通路計畫。 * 與顧客互動並評估顧客的獨特需求，提供客製化、有成效的購買與退貨解決方案和支援。 * 清楚表達產品的價值與優點，向顧客分享技術產品知識。 * 妥善處理顧客意見回饋並解決顧客疑慮或呈報的客訴，採取行動讓顧客「稱心如意」。 * 動態巡視整個樓面範圍，以評估並滿足業務、團隊和顧客的需求。 * 告知顧客當地社群計畫。規劃並執行本地、區域性和地區性的社群專案和計畫（例如：本地跑步俱樂部、國際瑜伽日）。 **與他人合作** * 秉持真摯友善的態度並頌揚多樣性，營造一個彼此尊重且具包容性的團隊環境，確保為所有團隊成員和顧客打造備受關心且引人入勝的體驗。 * 與所有團隊成員建立充滿支持且有益成效的關係。 * 與團隊成員合作，確保提供理想的顧客體驗，並支援門市營運。 **經營** * 為團隊成員提供樓面銷售引導，包括規劃銷售區域範圍並做出決策，以維持樓面經營效率和成效。檢視業務資料和指標，評估目標實現進度並確定是否須進行調整。 * 根據開店與關店檢查清單來準備門市的開店和關店作業。 * 依循公司標準管理產品展示任務（例如，將商品放回原位、補貨，或將售完的商品從庫存補回樓面、減少庫存或改變商品陳列位置）。 * 在值班期間視需要指派教育專員進行營運任務，維護門市環境格調。 * 確保團隊使用門市內的技術來支援門市營運，並提供正面的顧客體驗。 * 瞭解並遵守人員安全政策和程序，以維護安全的工作環境。 * 根據適用的政策、程序和法律或法規來執行工作。 **預算編製責任** 不適用 **人員管理** 經門市經理委派，擔任團隊領導角色，間接負責在樓面上部分的門市員工 **我們尋找的特質** * 包容與多元：建立／支持一個重視／讚揚差異性的包容環境 * 誠信／誠實：秉持誠實、公平與道德的態度行事 * 顧客體驗：熱愛工作且樂於建立連結、理解並協助顧客 * 共同合作與團隊合作： 有效地與他人合作並提供支援來達成目標；尋求合作關係並接納不同觀點 * 領導力：有能力並想要領導、影響和激勵他人；在工作中激勵人員、賦予權力、協助發展和提供指導 * 坦誠交流：願意公開且有建設性地分享考量（即直言不諱） new_jobs.title: 台灣區零售經理 Retail Store Manager
new_jobs.jd: 【您的重要角色】本職缺為鞋履品牌門市零售經理，全面統籌門市零售全流程營運工作，打造流暢、優質的顧客消費體驗。核心工作包括達成銷售目標、管控庫存、管理門市銷售員工團隊。理想候選人需具備紮實的零售管理從業背景、出色的領導能力，同時熱愛鞋履與時尚產業。 As a Retail Store Manager for a footwear brand, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the retail operations, ensuring a seamless and exceptional customer experience. You will play a key role in achieving sales targets, maintaining inventory levels, and leading a team of sales associates. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in retail management, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for footwear and fashion. 1\. 損益負責人 P\&L Owner • 統籌、管理、指導門市零售團隊，達成門市銷售目標，對門市盈虧負責。 • Meet sales goals by leading, managing, and mentoring the retail team. 2\. 門市營運 Store Operations • 統籌門市日常營運，保障門市工作流程順暢、高效運轉。 • Oversee day\-to\-day store operations to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. • 落實並嚴格執行標準化營運流程（SOP），提升門市營運效率。 • Implement and enforce standard operating procedures to optimize operational efficiency. • 管控門市陳列標準，透過優質視覺陳列充分展現品牌產品魅力。 • Manage and maintain visual merchandising standards to showcase the brand's products effectively. 3\. 銷售與客戶服務 Sales and Customer Service • 制定並達成銷售目標，極大化門市獲利水平。 • Set and achieve sales targets while maximizing profitability. • 培訓、激勵門市銷售員工，提供高標準客戶服務。 • Train and motivate sales associates to provide exceptional customer service. • 收集顧客回饋，執行優化方案，全面提升消費體驗。 • Monitor customer feedback and implement improvements to enhance the overall shopping experience. 4\. 業務拓展 Business Development • 零售展店與選址評估 Retail Expansion \& Site Acquisition • 結合客流數據、受眾輪廓、市場分析，挖掘並評估具備高發展潛力的新店、快閃店及專櫃點位。 Identify and evaluate high\-potential locations for new stores, pop\-ups, or shop\-in\-shops using traffic data, demographics, and market analysis. • 主導與房東、地產開發商、商場營運方洽談，爭取優厚租賃合作條件。 Lead negotiations with landlords, property developers, and shopping mall management to secure favourable lease terms. • 合作通路開發維護 Partner \& Channel Development • 搭建並維護與區域連鎖零售商、百貨商場、精品專營店的合作關係。 Build and manage relationships with regional retail chains, department stores, and specialty retailers. • 深度經營核心合作通路，提升貨品周轉、優化陳列位置、爭取優質推廣曝光資源。 Develop key partners to drive sell\-through, improve shelf space, and secure promotional visibility. 5\. 庫存管理 Inventory Management • 保障門市庫存數據即時、準確。 Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date inventory levels. • 落實庫存管控機制，減少庫存差異與貨品損耗。 Implement inventory control measures to minimize stock discrepancies and losses. • 協同商品企劃團隊，保證門市貨品結構均衡、款式具備吸引力。 Coordinate with the merchandising team to ensure a well\-balanced and appealing product assortment. 6\. 團隊管理 Team Leadership • 招聘、培訓、搭建高績效銷售團隊。 Recruit, train, and develop a high\-performing sales team. • 營造積極、協作的門市工作氛圍。 Foster a positive and collaborative work environment. • 定期開展員工績效考評，給予針對性改進指導。 Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback to team members. 7\. 銷售數據分析與匯報 Sales Analysis and Reporting • 分析門市銷售表現與市場趨勢，制定增收經營策略。 Analyze sales performance and market trends to develop strategies for increasing revenue. • 定期整理銷售、庫存及各類經營數據報表，向上級管理層匯報。 Prepare and present regular reports on sales, inventory, and other relevant metrics to management. 8\. 防損管控 Loss Prevention • 落實執行門市安防管控措施，防範貨品失竊，降低經營損耗。 Implement and enforce security measures to prevent theft and minimize losses. • 為員工開展防損培訓，監督全員落實防損規範。 Train staff on loss prevention techniques and monitor compliance. 9\. 行銷活動執行 Promotions and Marketing • 協同市場團隊落實各類促銷活動、門市主題活動。 Collaborate with the marketing team to implement promotional activities and events. • 確保門市銷售團隊充分掌握各類促銷、行銷活動資訊並執行到位。 Ensure effective communication of promotions and marketing campaigns to the sales team. 10\. 客戶關係維護 Customer Relationship Management • 維繫穩定良好的客群關係，提升顧客複購率。 Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to encourage repeat business. • 及時、專業地處理顧客投訴與各類客訴問題。 Address customer complaints and concerns in a timely and professional manner.

and simulation, end\-to\-end mechanical and electronic design industry processes is a plus * Experience working with customers in a variety of verticals such as high\-tech, semi\-conductors, synthesize unstructured data and present recommendations successfully to senior management * Ability to translate customer and industry requirements and trends into product roadmaps, solutions, and business growth **Additional Information** Cadence is committed to equal employment opportunity and employment equity throughout all levels of the organization. We strive to attract a qualified and diverse candidate pool and encourage diversity and inclusion in the workplace. **Travel:** \>30% **We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
